premises: Increasing configurational disorder in spinel oxides improves CO oxidation catalytic activity under dry, lean conditions.
A 7-metal HESO achieves a 63% lower T10 for CO oxidation compared to a 4-metal MESO.
A 7-metal HESO shows better long-term stability (4.7% vs 12.2% activity decrease over 14 h) than a 4-metal MESO.
The improved performance is linked to a decreased lattice parameter and increased oxygen vacancy concentration.
The benefits will translate to reduced platinum-group-metal consumption in automotive exhaust catalysts.
